guide_line: Dilute a solution with M1 V1 = M2 V2.
steps: Dilution adds solvent. Moles of solute stay the same.
M1 V1 = M2 V2. Keep both volumes in the same unit.
The final solution is weaker, so M2 is smaller than M1.
The stock volume you need is smaller than the final volume.
